scripts.setup:worker: python3 -m venv workers/.venv && workers/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r workers/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.smoke: tsx src/cli.ts run --topic "A lighthouse keeper discovers the light is alive" --scenes 3 --modes 1,1,1 --shots cut,continue,continue
scripts.smoke:full: tsx src/cli.ts run --topic "A lighthouse keeper discovers the light is alive" --scenes 4 --modes 1,1,2,1 --shots cut,continue,cut,cut --transition fade --bgm assets/music/example-bed.mp3
scripts.smoke:auto: tsx src/cli.ts run --topic "A hacker races to stop a rogue AI before midnight" --scenes 4 --mode auto --style cyberpunk --bgm assets/music/example-bed.mp3
scripts.smoke:brand: tsx src/cli.ts run --topic "A lost robot learns to paint" --scenes 4 --mode auto --style anime --brand assets/brand/example --bgm assets/music/example-bed.mp3
scripts.smoke:runpod: tsx src/cli.ts run --topic "A lighthouse keeper's daughter takes over the light" --scenes 4 --mode auto --provider runpod --style cinematic_history --brand assets/brand/example --bgm assets/music/example-bed.mp3
